newsitem.title: USA: THC officials resign, audit under way.
newsitem.headline: THC officials resign, audit under way.

text.p: THC Homecare Inc on Thursday said its board accepted the resignations of President and Chief Executive Officer Thomas Bushell and Chief Financial Officer William Trowbridge, as part of a corporate restructuring.

The company in a statement said the board appointed Larry Fuller, a director, as president and chief executive. It did not name a replacement for Trowbridge, and company officials were not immediately available for comment.
THC said its $2.5 million revolving line of credit from Heller Financial Services had been called and that Andersen Partners LLC was in the process of a complete audit of the company.
The board needed a timely and accurate understanding of the company's financial situation in order to best address the situation, THC said.
In order to start cutting operating costs, the company said it would close its Salt Lake City, Utah, office and operations would be managed from its Phoenix, Arizona, location.
